either disability benefits or a diagnostic code
cohort: The study included 921,218 Medicaid-insured live births in Texas from January 2010 to December 2014.
finding: Maternal disability was associated with adverse maternal and newborn outcomes regardless of how disability was defined, with the specific definition influencing the observed burden of disparities.
mod_finding: Mothers identified with only disability diagnostic codes showed the highest rates and adjusted risks for cesarean delivery.
